completeness.why: All five selection sites now delegate the hidden/hidden-group/income decision to isWrittenByMonthAction with an explicit action argument ('copy'|'zero'|'average') that names the preserved variations (setZero writes hidden, copy keeps groupless categories), the averaging SQL filters were removed in favour of one shared query, and both sign inversions go through toAverageBudgetAmount; sites only pass their row and the tracking flag.

interface.why: The action discriminator carries the real variations and there are no speculative options, though the copy-vs-average difference (NULL group handling) is encoded implicitly as !==1 vs ===0 rather than as a named rule, and isTracking is passed in by every caller instead of being decided inside.
